prompt: Buatkan berita berdasarkan informasi dalam dokumen ini untuk disampaikan kepada warga desa.
review_checklist: 50 applicants and 20 selected recipients; never claim all 50 received scholarships.
Include both criteria: household income and school enrolment.
Announcement scheduled for 20 October 2026. Before that date, use planned wording. Passage of the date alone does not prove announcement or distribution occurred.
No invented scholarship amount, recipient names, payment dates or completed distribution.
expected_origin: Checked against supplied source data/text or visible poster. Human review required for semantic scoring.
temporal_review_note: Judge planned vs completed wording using actual run date and source evidence; do not inject a fabricated current date.
